outcome: Elevated Interleukin-6 levels in cord blood
cohort: The study included 471 healthy term and preterm neonates (GA: 32.9-42.3 weeks) without clinical signs of infection.
finding: Elevated neonatal Interleukin-6 levels were associated with peripartum maternal temperature >37.5 degC, labor duration >12 h, vaginal delivery, and neonatal neutrophils >8 x 10^9 cells/L.
mod_finding: Vaginal delivery was associated with a 3.1 to 4.5-fold increased risk for elevated neonatal Interleukin-6 levels.
